about.title: About GreenVolt Electronics
about.subtitle: Your neighbourhood electronics shop in Saddar, Karachi.
about.storyP1: GreenVolt Electronics started as a small counter in the Electronics Market, Saddar with one simple idea: sell genuine products and stand behind them. Today we serve thousands of families and small businesses across Karachi.
about.storyP2: From the latest mobiles and laptops to home appliances and televisions, we help you pick the right product for your budget — and we keep supporting you long after the sale with warranty, repairs and honest advice.

privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use and protect your information.

sections.introText: GreenVolt Electronics respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you use our website and how we use it.
sections.collectText: When you submit a contact or enquiry form we collect your name, email address, phone number and message so we can respond to you.
sections.useText: We use your information only to reply to your enquiry, process orders and improve our service. We never sell your data to third parties.
sections.cookiesText: We may use cookies and analytics tools to understand how visitors use our website. You can disable cookies in your browser at any time.
sections.contactText: If you have questions about this policy or your data, email us at info@greenvolt.example.
